pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1080x1080 image
view: aerial, camera looking (near) straight down at a sand spit / beach with a large rock, sea (green water) at bottom and right

camera.evidence: phase correlation of every 6th frame vs frame 0: shift < 0.03 px; mean abs diff in rock region < 0.12 grey levels
camera.perspective_cues: near-nadir view: no horizon, no visible vanishing points; ground (sand + water surface) roughly fills the image as a plane facing the camera. Bird flies between camera and ground; its shadow on the sand is offset ~ +235 px x, -35 to -46 px y from the bird.

objects.name: bird
objects.description: the only animal: a dark (black-brown) bird with flapping wings, seen from above, sharp silhouette; flies left-to-right and slightly downwards across the image (from the sand over the shoreline onto the water)
objects.per_frame_step_px: 0 for frame 0->1 (frame 1 is a duplicate of frame 0), then 10.0-11.4 px/frame for every step 1->71 (median 10.8; slightly larger in the second half: mean ~10.5 frames 1-35, ~10.9 frames 36-71)
objects.heading_image_deg: about 15 deg below the +x axis (down-right), with small wiggles

apparent_size_px.trend: no systematic growth or shrinkage over the clip (changes come from wing flapping / pose), so the bird's camera distance stays roughly constant

objects.name: bird_shadow
objects.description: soft, blurred dark shape on the sand to the upper right of the bird (~240 px away), moving parallel to it and mirroring its wing pose; interpreted as the bird's cast shadow (not a second bird): it is blurrier than the bird and fades out over the water
objects.note: very faint after frame ~35 (over the water); lost after frame 41

objects.name: rock
objects.description: large boulder / rock outcrop, white-lit on its left side, dark shadowed facets on its right; upper middle of the image, on the sand next to the water
objects.reliability: +-15 px; mask includes a thin strip of sand on the right edge; top edge at/near y = 0 (rock may be cut by the frame top)

objects.name: sand_spit
objects.description: pale pink-beige sand area (beach) covering the upper-left part of the image, with lighter concentric bands; its edge to the water runs from about (0, 470) at the left down to its lowest point near (360, 770), then up-right to about (1000, 0)

objects.name: water
objects.description: dark green sea occupying the lower-left, bottom and right of the image, with a light green shallow band along the sand edge

events.event: clip starts with the bird already in flight
frame 1 identical to frame 0 (no motion between them; true for whole image)
shadow leaves the sand onto the shallow water / starts fading
bird crosses the sand edge and flies over the water (contrast drop)
clip ends, bird still flying over the water
